I am currently supporting a client leading international industrial manufacturing organisation based in Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a major business transformation programme.

 

 

The organisation is undertaking a significant transformation of its core business and operational processes, including the modernisation and harmonisation of ERP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics and related business systems.

This is a business-critical transformation programme involving multiple stakeholders across manufacturing sites and functions, with a strong focus on process standardisation, operational efficiency and the transition from legacy ways of working to a modern target operating model.
Terms

• Freelance / Long-term contract - 12 months, with possible extensions

• Location: Antwerp, Belgium

• Hybrid: 2 days on-site per week

• Language: English-speaking (Dutch is beneficial)

• Rate: Negotiable depending on experience

Key Responsibilities

• Analyse and document current AS-IS manufacturing and supply chain processes

• Define and document TO-BE processes as part of the transformation programme

• Lead requirements gathering across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics and Operations

• Facilitate workshops with business process owners, subject matter experts and key stakeholders

• Identify process gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for standardisation and improvement

• Translate business requirements into clear functional requirements and specifications

• Perform fit-gap analysis between existing processes, business requirements and the target ERP / business systems

• Support the design and implementation of harmonised processes across multiple manufacturing sites

• Work closely with ERP functional teams, solution architects, technical teams and implementation partners

• Support integration and process dependencies across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehousing and Logistics

• Contribute to data migration, testing, UAT, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities

• Ensure business requirements and process documentation remain aligned throughout the transformation

• Act as a key bridge between business stakeholders and technical / implementation teams

• Support change adoption and the transition to the new processes and systems

• 
 

Project Context

• Major manufacturing transformation programme

• International industrial / discrete manufacturing organisation

• Antwerp-based with multiple operational / manufacturing stakeholders

• Transformation of legacy business processes and systems

• Strong focus on ERP, Manufacturing and Supply Chain transformation

• Harmonisation and standardisation of processes across sites

• Transformation covering Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics and Operations

• Significant business process redesign and improvement component

• International business and technology stakeholders

• Collaboration with external implementation / technology partners

• Long-term programme with multiple transformation phases, including design, implementation, migration, testing and go-live

 

 

 

If you are interested please apply for this role or send your CV to harry.rankin@g2recruitment.com

Candidates must have experience within a manufacturing environment, ideally within industrial / discrete manufacturing.

 

 

Strong experience across areas such as:

• Production planning and scheduling

• Manufacturing operations

• Supply Chain

• Procurement

• Inventory / materials management

• Warehouse and logistics

• MRP / planning processes

• Order-to-delivery processes

• Manufacturing master data

• Plant / site operations

• ERP-enabled manufacturing processes

• Experience working across multiple manufacturing sites or international operations would be highly advantageous.

Profile

• Strong experience as a Senior Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Functional Analyst or ERP Business Analyst

• Proven track record delivering business transformation, ERP implementation, migration or rollout programmes

• Excellent experience with AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping and fit-gap analysis

• Experience facilitating workshops with senior business stakeholders and process owners

• Comfortable working between business, functional and technical teams

• Experience working with systems integrators / implementation partners

• Experience across testing, UAT, data migration and go-live activities

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: B Driver with progression to CE
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a truck driver and gradually work your way up to a CE driving licence? With our client, you will have the opportunity to learn the profession and develop your skills step by step.

As a B driver for this major logistics company, you will help ensure that food products are delivered safely and on time to customers every day. You will start by making deliveries with a van and receive guidance and training to obtain your CE driving licence.

- You drive a van as a B driver and make deliveries
- You learn the routes, customers and working methods
- You actively help with loading and unloading goods
- You check your load and ensure correct delivery
- You are in daily contact with customers and represent the company
- You follow training to progress to a CE driver position
- You accurately complete transport documents
- You work according to all safety and hygiene regulations

You will join a professional environment where you are guided step by step in your development. This is your opportunity to become a skilled truck driver with plenty of opportunities for further growth.

During the onboarding period, you will work in the warehouse in a two-shift system. If this period goes well, you will start the training and receive a contract with the company.
- Vaardigheden:
You are motivated to become a truck driver
You are open to a training programme towards obtaining your CE driving licence
You are responsible and calm in traffic
You are customer-friendly and communicate fluently
You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety

- Attesten:
You hold a valid B driving licence.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
/

- Vakkennis:
Previous experience as a driver is an advantage

- Talenkennis:
You speak and understand English well
